title: Russian Drone Strikes Kill 5 in Kherson, Including Minibus Attack
detail: Russian forces attacked a minibus in Kherson's Korabelnyi district with a drone at around 08:50, killing four people — a 69-year-old man and three women aged 89, 63, and 71 — and wounding five others. Later the same day, around 13:00, a separate Russian drone strike on a Kherson street killed a 62-year-old woman. Damage across the city included three apartment buildings, a restaurant, and several vehicles.

title: Russian 'Banderol' Drone Double-Tap Strike on Zhytomyr Police HQ Kills 3, Injures 53
detail: Russian forces struck the Main Directorate of the National Police headquarters in Zhytomyr Oblast at 18:34 with jet-powered Banderol-type (S8000) loitering munitions in a double-tap attack, killing 3 people — including named officers Captain Artem Zubchuk and Lieutenant Colonel Yuliia Yevdokymova — and injuring 53. The strike sparked a fire on the roof and fourth floor of the building. It was the second major Russian attack on Zhytomyr in roughly ten days, following a similar drone strike on August 9. Interior Minister Ivan Vyhivskyi and First Deputy Head of the National Police Maksym Tsutskiridze condemned the attack as deliberate targeting of police and emergency responders.

media.caption: Damage to the National Police headquarters building in Zhytomyr after a Russian Banderol drone strike, August 19, 2026

title: Russian Drones Strike Zaporizhzhia Market and Hostel, Killing One
detail: Russian drones struck Zaporizhzhia's central market at around 01:37, destroying a shopping complex, damaging vendor kiosks and stored merchandise, and igniting a fire that spread to a nearby hostel just a few meters away. One person was killed in the hostel. The Zaporizhzhia Regional Prosecutor's Office opened a war-crimes investigation into the strike.

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Oil Refinery in Ufa, Target Tula and Nizhny Novgorod Arsenals
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones reportedly struck the Bashneft-UNPZ oil refinery in Ufa, Bashkortostan, sparking a fire, and damaged a residential building in the city's Zaton district, injuring one person. Drones also reportedly targeted the 53rd Arsenal of Russia's Main Missile and Artillery Directorate in Dzerzhinsk, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, and the Novomoskovsk area of Tula Oblast, where falling debris damaged houses, cars, and an apartment building. Ukraine's military had not confirmed the strikes at the time of reporting; Russia's Defense Ministry claimed it downed 453 Ukrainian drones across 21 regions overnight.

media.caption: Aftermath of a Ukrainian drone strike on Russian territory, August 19, 2026
